title: A Structure-Preserving LOBPCG Method for Computing Several of the Largest Generalized Singular Triplets
summary: We develop a structure-preserving locally optimal block preconditioned conjugate gradient(LOBPCG) method for computing several of the largest positive generalized singular values of a matrix pair \((A, B)\), where \(B\) has full column rank, together with the associated generalized singular vectors. The method is derived from the Hermitian-definite Jordan--Wielandt pencil and therefore avoids explicitly forming the normal-equation matrices.
